title: Souvenir and send-off
subtopic: S11 — One thing you can act on
learning_goal: Leave with one findable, free thing to do — stand on the spot Britain measures its road distances from.

narration.script: One thing to take away. The next time you pass a sign that says LONDON and a number, you will know exactly what is being measured. Tomorrow: Dover and Calais — twenty miles of water, and why both sides are white.
